summary.tldr: Adds Ojibway National Urban Park of Canada to the Canada National Parks Act and sets out its Ontario land boundaries.
what_it_does: Creates Ojibway National Urban Park of Canada by adding it to Part 5 of Schedule 1 of the Canada National Parks Act.
Defines the park as seven parcels of land in Ontario, in and around Windsor.
Sets out the exact boundary lines for each parcel using coordinates based on NAD83.
States the parcels cover about 323.4 hectares in total.
